investigations.stage: candidate numerical smoke test before timing
investigations.error: reinterpret_cast from const constant float* to const device float4* is not allowed
investigations.interpretation: MLX uses constant address space for small buffers. Candidate source must support both address spaces.
investigations.repair: Constant/device overloads, subsequently changed to packed_float4 for offset alignment. Every repaired candidate requires fresh numerical checks.

investigations.outcome: semantically unsuitable as standalone stable clamped L2 fallback
investigations.reason: rms_norm(..., eps=0) on a zero row produces NaNs; nonzero additive epsilon differs from max(norm(x), 1e-12). Ordinary L2 also overflows on large finite float32 rows.
investigations.decision: Retain as competing library implementation for normal-magnitude vectors, never substitute silently for declared stable semantics.

investigations.evidence: ../protocol.json contains unmodified 40-pair identical-baseline samples for each of three application shapes
investigations.observation: load_average=[685.9614,543.8423,314.5239]. Identical-baseline 95% speedup intervals include 0.436..2.610. pmset reported no recorded thermal warning, not a temperature measurement.
investigations.decision: No candidate tuning or promotion from this protocol. Keep it as a failed study. Require a new quiet-period baseline with a prospectively fixed stability gate before freezing replacement confirmation. Never rerun confirmation to seek a lucky win.
